description: Defines the SocketWatcherFactory class implementing thread-safe socket performance monitoring, including creation of socket watchers, callback mechanisms for RTT updates, and testing utilities.

classes.name: SocketWatcherFactory
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe factory for creating socket performance watchers, managing RTT observation callbacks, notification intervals, and test configurations.

methods.name: SocketWatcherFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with task runner, notification interval, RTT update callback, RTT notification callback, and tick clock.

methods.name: CreateSocketPerformanceWatcher
methods.description: Creates a new socket performance watcher for a specified protocol and IP address.

methods.name: SetUseLocalHostRequestsForTesting
methods.description: Sets whether to allow RTT measurements from localhost addresses for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Overrides the tick clock used by the factory for testing.
